learn.hook: Clap once. That took about one second! How many claps fit in a minute?
points: A second is a very short time, about one clap.
Minutes to seconds: multiply by 60. 3 minutes = 3 × 60 = 180 seconds.
Seconds to minutes: divide by 60. 240 seconds = 4 minutes.
learn.reallife: Races, cooking timers, cricket over timings and video clips use seconds and minutes.

quiz.q: How many seconds make 1 minute?
quiz.mistake: Thinks time works in hundreds like money

quiz.q: How many seconds are there in 3 minutes?
quiz.mistake: Adds 60 + 3, or uses 100 seconds in a minute

quiz.q: Write 2 minutes 15 seconds in seconds.
quiz.mistake: Writes the numbers side by side (215)

quiz.q: 240 seconds is how many minutes?
quiz.mistake: Divides by 10 instead of 60

quiz.q: Which of these takes about one second?
quiz.explain: A single clap is very quick, about one second.
quiz.mistake: Has no feel for how short a second is

quiz.q: How many seconds are there in 1 hour?
quiz.explain: 1 hour = 60 minutes, and each minute is 60 seconds. 60 × 60 = 3,600.
quiz.mistake: Multiplies 60 × 6 instead of 60 × 60

quiz.q: 90 seconds is the same as…
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 minute is 100 seconds or 40 seconds

quiz.q: Riya held her breath for 45 seconds. Arjun held his for 1 minute. How many seconds longer was Arjun?
quiz.mistake: Takes 1 minute as 100 seconds, or adds

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I change minutes into seconds?'
teach.praise: Tick tock! Each minute has 60 seconds, so I multiply by 60!
teach.nudge: How many seconds are in one minute? What do I do with that number?

learn.hook: Your train leaves at 9:40 a.m. and reaches at 11:15 a.m. How long will you be looking out of the window?
points: Duration means how long something takes, from the start time to the end time.
Count on from the start: first to the next full hour, then whole hours, then the extra minutes.
a.m. is from midnight to noon. p.m. is from noon to midnight.
To find an end time, add the duration to the start time. 60 minutes make 1 hour.

example.q: A train leaves at 9:40 a.m. and arrives at 11:15 a.m. How long is the journey?

learn.reallife: Train timetables, school periods and TV shows all have start times, end times and durations.

games.title: Kabir's day
games.prompt: Put Kabir's day in order of time

items.text: From 3:00 p.m. to 3:45 p.m. is ___ minutes
From 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. is ___ hours
Half an hour after 4:45 p.m. is ___

quiz.q: A cricket match starts at 2:00 p.m. and ends at 5:30 p.m. How long does it last?
quiz.explain: 2:00 to 5:00 is 3 hours. 5:00 to 5:30 is 30 minutes more.
quiz.mistake: Forgets the extra 30 minutes

quiz.q: A film starts at 6:15 p.m. and lasts 2 hours 20 minutes. When does it end?
quiz.mistake: Adds only the hours

quiz.q: School runs from 8:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. How long is the school day?
quiz.explain: 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon is 4 hours. Noon to 1:30 p.m. is 1 hour 30 minutes. Total 5 hours 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Does 8 − 1 and gets confused crossing noon

quiz.q: Meena starts her homework at 4:50 p.m. and finishes at 5:25 p.m. How many minutes does she take?
quiz.explain: 4:50 to 5:00 is 10 minutes. 5:00 to 5:25 is 25 minutes. 10 + 25 = 35.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 50 − 25 or treats an hour as 100 minutes

quiz.q: Kabir's train leaves at 10:45 a.m. The journey takes 50 minutes. When does it arrive?
quiz.mistake: Thinks 45 + 50 makes 95 minutes past 10

quiz.q: Joseph sleeps from 9:30 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. How long does he sleep?
quiz.explain: 9:30 p.m. to midnight is 2 hours 30 minutes. Midnight to 6:00 a.m. is 6 hours. Total 8 hours 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 9:30 − 6:00 without thinking about midnight

quiz.q: A bus ride takes 1 hour 15 minutes. How many minutes is that?
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 hour is 100 minutes

quiz.q: Aisha practises the flute for 25 minutes every day for 4 days. How long does she practise in all?
quiz.mistake: Changes 100 minutes into 1 hour 0 minutes, as if an hour were 100 minutes

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'My nap starts at 1:40 and ends at 2:15. How do I find how long I slept?'
teach.praise: Yawn! 1:40 to 2:00 is 20 minutes, then 15 more. 35 minutes of sleep!
teach.nudge: Where do I start counting? Is it easier to go to the next full hour first?

learn.hook: Ready, steady, go! In a race, the smallest time wins. Let's read stopwatches like a sports judge!
points: In a race, the runner who takes the least time is the fastest.
To compare times, write them in the same unit, usually seconds.
1 minute 5 seconds = 65 seconds, which is more than 58 seconds.
The difference between two times tells how much faster one runner is.

example.q: Riya ran in 52 seconds, Aisha in 1 minute 3 seconds and Harpreet in 49 seconds. Who won? Put them in order.
example.answer: Harpreet won; then Riya, then Aisha

learn.reallife: Sports days, the Olympics and car races measure winners in seconds and even parts of a second.

games.title: How long does it take?
items: a train ride from Delhi to Mumbai

games.title: True or false?
items: In a race, the runner with the least time wins.
A blink of an eye takes about 1 hour.
A blink takes much less than a second.

quiz.q: In a 50 m race, Arjun took 14 seconds, Kabir 12 seconds and Joseph 15 seconds. Who won?
quiz.explain: The smallest time wins. Kabir took only 12 seconds.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the biggest number wins

quiz.q: In that race, Kabir took 12 seconds and Joseph took 15 seconds. How many seconds faster was Kabir?
quiz.mistake: Adds the times instead of finding the difference

quiz.q: Which is less time: 1 minute 5 seconds or 58 seconds?
quiz.explain: 1 minute 5 seconds = 65 seconds. 58 is less than 65.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 58 is more because 58 is bigger than 5

quiz.q: Four relay runners took 15, 14, 16 and 15 seconds. What was the team's total time?
quiz.mistake: Leaves out one runner

quiz.q: A stopwatch shows 1 minute 20 seconds. How many seconds is that?
quiz.mistake: Writes 1 and 20 side by side as 120

quiz.q: Meena ran the race in 58 seconds last week and 51 seconds today. By how many seconds did she improve?
quiz.explain: 58 − 51 = 7 seconds less, so she is 7 seconds faster.
quiz.mistake: Adds the two times

quiz.q: Riya ran in 50 seconds, Arjun in 47 seconds and Aisha in 53 seconds. Who came second?
quiz.explain: Order of times: 47 (Arjun), 50 (Riya), 53 (Aisha). Riya is second.
quiz.mistake: Orders from the biggest time

quiz.q: Harpreet's heart beats about 80 times in a minute. About how many times does it beat in 30 seconds?
quiz.explain: 30 seconds is half a minute. Half of 80 is 40.
quiz.mistake: Doubles instead of halving

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I know who is the fastest in a race?'
teach.praise: Zoom! The one who takes the least time wins. I'm racing the sparrows now!
teach.nudge: Does the fastest runner take more time or less time? How do I compare 1 minute 5 seconds and 58 seconds?
